review.content_class_rationale: ZIP of two members. The PDF member (10 pages, all read) holds supplementary methods text, a primer table and ExAC population-frequency tables with no patient clinical data. The XLSX member (six sheets: Table S1 sequencing metrics, S2 variant summary, S3 proband coding SNPs, S4 proband coding INDELs, S5 inheritance counts, S10 sibling coding SNPs) is whole-exome variant data; its header rows and row counts were read from the workbook XML but not every cell.

review.notes: Mixed archive: methods/primer/population-frequency PDF plus research variant tables for the proband (S3, S4, S5) and family or sibling (S1, S2, S10). Not marked EHR-includable because the tables are research exome call lists rather than a clinical record; the parent should rule on this. No clinical values are entered here.
limitations: XLSX member not covered by any dense supplement document review path (a ZIP with a non-PDF member is partial in supplement_review); only sheet names, header rows and row counts were inspected, not every cell.

Table S1 and S2 have per-sample rows that include the proband alongside other family members; S3 and S4 list proband variants but also carry father, mother and sibling genotype columns; S5 is proband inheritance counts; S10 lists the sibling coding SNPs. Patient scope p1 therefore covers only the proband-labelled content, and rows or columns for other family members are not p1 data.
Manifest completed by an annotator who read all PDF pages and inspected the XLSX structure; see the file review limitations.
